mapper.select: SELECT P.PLACE_NO , P.PLACE_NAME , P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION , P.ADDR , P.X_AXIS , P.Y_AXIS , PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN PLACE_IMG PI ON P.PLACE_NO = PI.PLACE_NO AND PI.IMG_ORDER = 1 WHERE P.PLACE_NO = #{placeNo}

SELECT P.PLACE_NO , P.PLACE_NAME , P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION , P.ADDR , P.X_AXIS , P.Y_AXIS , PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME AS IMAGE_URL FROM TYPE_DETAIL T LEFT JOIN PLACE P ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = T.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN PLACE_IMG PI ON PI.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND PI.IMG_ORDER = 1 WHERE T.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = #{typeDetailNo} AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO
